core_concept: A physical photo strip in a digital space. The app should feel warm, intimate, and emotionally intelligent, with hard-bordered physical-feeling UI elements that contrast softly against a textured pastel background. Privacy ('we don't store anything') is communicated through an honest, raw, and direct visual tone, rather than sterile legal text.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black

rules: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for structure, CTA, and primary navigation.
Use 'Satoshi' for body text, form inputs, and secondary information.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' strictly in italic format for emotional accent words (e.g., 'together', 'memories') within larger headings to create romantic visual tension.
Privacy messaging must be highly legible, slightly oversized, and NOT hidden in fine print.
No full-screen gradients. Focus on flat, matte colors that feel like paper and physical cards.
Borders are critical: Use solid Charcoal (#1A1A19) borders (1px or 2px) for cards, buttons, and camera frames to create the tactile 'Neo-brutalist' physical feel.
Primary brand color (#E07A5F) is reserved for the most critical actions (Start Session, Capture).

patterns.landing: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. Mix large typography with floating polaroid-style image cards.
patterns.camera_room: Split screen. Mobile: Top/Bottom split. Desktop: Left/Right 50/50 split.
patterns.photo_strip: Vertical column format with thick white padding around photos and hard outer borders, perfectly mimicking a classic physical photobooth strip.

camera_specific.frame_padding: p-2 sm:p-4 bg-white border-2 border-charcoal shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,25,1)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#E07A5F] text-[#FDFBF7] font-bold border-2 border-[#1A1A19] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,25,1)] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,25,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] transition-all px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest
buttons.secondary: bg-[#FDFBF7] text-[#1A1A19] font-bold border-2 border-[#1A1A19] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,25,1)] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(26,26,25,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] transition-all px-8 py-4 uppercase tracking-widest

surfaces_and_components.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-[#1A1A19] rounded-none px-4 py-3 text-lg font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E07A5F] placeholder:font-normal placeholder:text-[#4A4A48]/50

camera_view.waiting_overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center z-10 text-[#1A1A19] font-bold
camera_view.countdown_overlay: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-20 pointer-events-none

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Instant or very fast fade (0.2s). Avoid sluggish routing.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hard shadows compress (translate x/y and shadow offset reduction) to feel like physical buttons being pushed.
motion_and_interactions.countdown: Numbers scale down from 150% to 100% while fading in, emphasizing the impending capture. Use a bold, punchy font for the numbers.
motion_and_interactions.photo_strip_reveal: Slide up from bottom with a slight rotation, mimicking a strip printing out of a machine.

images.description: Couple polaroid photo. Use this as a floating, slightly tilted card on the landing page to instantly communicate the end result.

images.placement: background_overlay (use with low opacity and mix-blend-multiply)

icons.style: stroke-width 2.5, sharp corners if possible, colored #1A1A19.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all layout building using pure HTML and Tailwind CSS (no Shadcn for layout shells) to strictly maintain the Neo-brutalist tactile aesthetic.
Ensure 'We don't store anything' messaging is prominent on the Landing Page and inside the Waiting Room. Make it a bold typographic feature, not an afterthought.
Camera Permissions UX: Show a clear, direct 'Enable Camera' button state before accessing `getUserMedia`. Handle iOS Safari quirks by ensuring camera triggers on a direct user interaction.
Mobile Split Screen: Must stack vertically (User on top, Partner on bottom, or vice-versa) with absolutely zero gap between them, divided by a 2px solid charcoal line.

Final Photo Strip: Render this using an HTML Canvas element so it can be seamlessly downloaded as a single image. Ensure a white background, consistent padding between the 6 shots (3 left, 3 right), and a playful footer at the bottom of the strip.
WebSockets: Display clear connection status indicators. If a partner disconnects, transition smoothly to an 'Abandoned' state rather than breaking the UI.
Include `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, camera containers, countdown elements).
